Support for the PMAC of the Gigabit switch (GSWIP) inside the
	  Lantiq / Intel VRX200 VDSL SoC

*  - firstbuf/nextbuf are 4 bit ring pointers that wrap at 16 while the
 *    slots are indexed with (buf & 7): the ring has eight slots of 2 KiB.
 *  - The MAC has no transmit done interrupt, TPLR bit 31 has to be polled.
 *  - There is no per frame receive error status: the AXIS tuser output of
 *    axis_gmii_rx (bad FCS) is not routed to the register file and no error
 *    counter exists. The driver checks the retained FCS in software and
 *    reports only errors that it can establish from the frame bytes.
